messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)
I'll pull up your order now.
Handed to the team · Order over 3 weeks past its ship date with no new date on it.

Thanks for your patience, John, and I'm sorry: your GekkoScience KBOX was due to ship September 30 and it hasn't, because the unit is still waiting on stock at our warehouse. You should have heard from us about that and you didn't. That's on us.

I don't have a confirmed new ship date yet, so I've put it in front of the team to pin down. They're offline now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to this email address, so you don't need to wait here.

Understood. You'll hear from them tomorrow with a firm date.

If you'd rather not wait on the KBOX, I can look at swapping it for something that's on the shelf now. Just say the word and I'll check what's available for (address hidden).

Appreciate that, John. For the wait I've put $50 off your next order on this: code HD-••••••. It's yours alone and works on orders over $200.

You'll get the confirmed KBOX ship date by email, and tracking as soon as it leaves the warehouse.
ON SEPT 26 IT SAID MY ORDER IS IN AND READY TO SHIP ???

You're right to be annoyed. When you bought it, the listing showed September 30 as the ship date, and that's the date stamped on your order. The unit then wasn't on the shelf when the warehouse went to pick it, and nobody wrote to tell you. Both of those are on us.

What I can see right now is that it's still waiting on stock, which is why I'm not giving you a date I can't stand behind. The confirmed one comes to your email tomorrow.
You're all set, John. Nothing more needed from you here. The ship date comes to your email, and tracking follows as soon as the KBOX leaves the warehouse.
